name: @pipeworx/mcp-google_calendar

tools.name: gcal_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events with optional date filtering. Returns event summaries, start/end times, attendees, and locations. Use to view upcoming or past events.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID (default: "primary" for the user's main calendar)

time_min.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for event start time as RFC3339 timestamp (e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

time_max.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for event end time as RFC3339 timestamp

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 10, max 250)

order_by.description: Sort order (default: startTime). startTime requires singleEvents=true.

tools.name: gcal_get_event
tools.description: Get full details of a specific event by ID (e.g., "event_12345"). Returns summary, description, times, attendees, location, and video conferencing links.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to retrieve

tools.name: gcal_create_event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event with summary, start/end times, optional description, location, and attendee emails. Returns the created event ID.

start.description: Start time as RFC3339 timestamp (e.g., "2024-06-15T10:00:00-07:00") or date for all-day events ("2024-06-15")

end.description: End time as RFC3339 timestamp or date for all-day events

description.description: Description or notes for the event

time_zone.description: Time zone (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles"). Defaults to calendar's time zone.

tools.name: gcal_list_calendars
tools.description: List all accessible calendars. Returns calendar IDs, names, time zones, and your access level for each. Use to identify which calendar to query or modify.

tools.name: gcal_search_events
tools.description: Search events by keyword across summaries, descriptions, locations, and attendees. Returns matching event details and times. Use to find events by topic or participant.

query.description: Free-text search query to match against event fields

time_min.description: Lower bound for event start time as RFC3339 timestamp

time_max.description: Upper bound for event end time as RFC3339 timestamp

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 10, max 250)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-google_calendar forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the google_calendar pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
